comment.narrative: There is no output level indicators mentioned in the revised log frame of the project which was done during the project extension in 2020. Therefore the indicators here for the OUTPUT level results which have been derived from the respective Activity Indicators of the outputs of the revised log frame and found to be best suited to measure and monitor that output. Pre training information has been collected as baseline information.Although the project started in 2017 but the project could start its implementation activity as well as needs assessment and baseline studiesreview from 1 January 2018 from the month it received the Government approval.

Project has the target to train female and PWDs in EDT but now target number is set as per the log frame.There is no output level indicators mentioned in the revised log frame of the project which was done during the project extension in 2020. Therefore the indicators here for the OUTPUT level results which have been derived from the respective Activity Indicators of the outputs of the revised log frame and found to be best suited to measure and monitor that output. The timeline for target has been revised as per no cost extension plan of 2022.
The information provided is derived from the Internal Database system and has been verified through internal monitoring systems.
